name: TASHIN
recent: Tashin Holdings 在 2026 年第三季度净利同比增长 40.4% 至 154.3 万令吉，首九个月净利大增 133.1%。公司近期也出现董事在公开市场增持股份，以及公司秘书变更。
notable: 2026 年第三季度净利同比增长 40.4% 至 154.3 万令吉，首九个月净利增长 133.1%。
独立非执行董事 Ir Tan Tiong Ben 于 2025 年 9 月 17 日至 19 日期间在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司秘书 Chen Chee Kee 变更。

news.title: Tashin Holdings Q3 2026 Net Profit Up 40.4% to RM1.543 Million, 9M Profit Surges 133.1%

recent_en: Tashin Holdings' Q3 2026 net profit rose 40.4% year-on-year to RM1.543 million, with 9M profit surging 133.1%. The company also saw directors acquiring shares in the open market and a change of company secretary.
notable_en: Q3 2026 net profit rose 40.4% year-on-year to RM1.543 million, with 9M profit up 133.1%.
Independent Non-Executive Director Ir Tan Tiong Ben acquired shares in the open market between 17 and 19 September 2025.
Change of Company Secretary to Chen Chee Kee.
